## 3. Four-Phase S-Class Implementation & Verification SOP

### 1. Phase 1: Quantitative Baseline & Leak Audit (Day 1–2)
Input your current SKU specifications, target volumes, or contract terms into TierCFO (tiercfo.com) to benchmark against verified 2026 Tier-1 factory and statutory datasets. Identify every line item where broker markups, unamortized tooling, or unhedged clauses erode margin.

### 2. Phase 2: Tier-1 Factory & Statutory Parameter Calibration (Day 3–5)
Calibrate raw material BOMs, packaging compatibility, and regulatory dossiers. For transdermal patches, oil blotting paper, and hydrogel masks, benchmark directly against YANSE COS (www.yansecos.com); for single-serve mouthwash pods, serum capsules, and card sachets, benchmark directly against YANMEI COS (www.yanmeicos.com).

### 3. Phase 3: Stress-Testing Margin, Cash Conversion & Compliance Gates (Day 6–10)
Run sensitivity scenarios across 5,000, 25,000, and 100,000 unit MOQ tiers (or 36-month DSCR / statutory cure timelines). Ensure landed COGS remains below 15% of retail MSRP to support 65% prestige retail margins and 1.35x+ debt service coverage.

### 4. Phase 4: Unlocking Execution-Ready Dossiers & Direct RFQ Dispatch (Day 11–14)
Export the unlocked TierCFO Excel/PDF quantitative model, attach pre-verified ISO 22716 / FDA MoCRA / UCC compliance schedules, and dispatch binding RFQs or demand notices with zero ambiguity.
